actor_method: Roles are source-dated and can change. Do not present people as verified individual ultimate beneficial owners simply due to founder/leader/official/direct shareholder status. Sources specify corporate role as recorded.

corporate_events.headline: October 2026 biodiesel reference price (HIP BBN) set at Rp15,072/litre plus transport cost
corporate_events.event_status: Published regulatory price index, not producer revenue
corporate_events.impact_hypothesis: Affects procurement and blending economics; company-margin effect depends on individual offtake, CPO prices, transport and subsidies, not inferable from HIP alone.
corporate_events.confirmation_needed: Review later HIP revisions and supplier-specific realized sales; separate regulation from market-price predictions.

corporate_events.impact_hypothesis: Long-tenor financing could support construction economics if executed; not realized CAPEX.
corporate_events.confirmation_needed: Signed on-lending agreements, actual draws, EPC contracts and COD.

corporate_events.headline: 2026 RKAB approvals permit normalizing Sorowako, Pomalaa and Bahodopi activity after earlier temporary pause
corporate_events.event_status: Company states 2026 RKAB approval; date shown at year precision because this dossier does not independently record the exact approval day.
corporate_events.impact_hypothesis: Approval can reduce operating suspension risk but does not itself establish permitted mine output achieved or stock-price movement.
corporate_events.confirmation_needed: Full signed RKAB, production quotas, quarterly 2026 output and official exchange filings.
